purpose: Generated modeling references, not screenshots of the running game.

sheets.brief: Three-view chibi salaryman turnaround: huge shouting mouth with two teeth and tongue, thick cheeks, worried pupils, swept sculpted locks, rolled sleeves, loose red tie, navy trousers, oversized shoes and tilted employee ID. Shared rounded toy-office style; used as style reference for the following eight sheets.

sheets.prompt:
Brand new modeling reference sheet for the original Japanese absurd office-chair escape game Zenryoku Taikin / 全力退勤. Match the attached employee turnaround's warm ivory studio background, expressive chunky molded toy/vinyl/clay forms, beveled edges, clean substantial silhouettes, restrained sculpted detail, soft contact shadows, and palette (ivory #F4F0E8, tomato #E63B2F, teal #3E8F87, navy #26323F, golden yellow #F6B45F; tiny magenta/cyan accents). This is a coherent comic game asset, NOT photorealism and NOT a gameplay scene. No HUD, no office backdrop, no thin fragile detail. Every row shows EXACTLY the SAME object in 3 columns FRONT / RIGHT SIDE / BACK. Orthographic or very mild orthographic studio cameras; matching scale and baseline within each row, no cropping. Full objects visible. Labels are short and unobtrusive. Practical lightweight Blender-model shapes, no dramatic illustration motion or effects.
Two rows, six large clear render panels. Top row: an absurdly overstuffed teal ergonomic office chair. Thick asymmetrical marshmallow cushion and backrest with navy piping, a few broad seams, big dark padded armrests, a sturdy lift with a huge orange adjustment paddle, five slightly bent navy star legs ending in fat paired black casters; like a tiny office racing vehicle, recognizable and hilariously overconfident. No person. Bottom row: a squat oversized tomato-red fire extinguisher with rounded shoulders and base, black foot ring, brass valve, exaggerated broad squeeze levers, a readable cream pressure dial with colored arc, chunky white instruction label with simple red extinguisher pictogram and stripes, a thick curved dark hose and trumpet-like nozzle aimed rearward. No flames or powder. Both must match the employee's adult comic toy world.

She has a huge rounded adult chibi head, a smooth chestnut asymmetric bob hair silhouette, very heavy half-closed sleepy eyelids, slightly lopsided smug indifferent smile, plump cheeks, cream shirt with pink rolled cuffs, teal vest, navy baggy trousers and big black shoes, crooked small ID badge. Utterly oblivious to ridiculous chaos, much calmer than the panic employee, but clearly the same game's anatomy and sculpted toy quality. Same hands, feet and hair design across all three views. Do not make a featureless block person.
